svg.title: Keep the export task in one retrievable chunk
svg.desc: A fictional project handbook becomes two independently retrievable chunks. The export chunk keeps its definition, four-step procedure, and linked-file exception together. Splitting after the steps would omit the instruction to download linked files separately before sharing a complete copy. The unrelated billing FAQ becomes its own chunk.
svg.text: Bad split: the export steps lose their exception.
Fictional handbook; chunks are not to scale.
